description: coreams01 is an Intel Atom C2750: SSE4.2 but no AVX/AVX2/AVX-512.
ClickHouse builds from 26.5.3 onward abort with 'Illegal instruction
(core dumped)' in the entrypoint, before the server starts, so the
container restart-loops and the whole data platform is down.
The version ceiling blocks the known-bad range and automerge is off so
nothing in the allowed range lands unreviewed. Before raising this,
test the candidate ON THE HOST:
Synapse auth is delegated to MAS via MSC3861, configured in
that key after v1.155.0 in favour of a top-level
matrix_authentication_service block, so newer versions exit at startup
and the container restart-loops — taking Matrix and, with it, alert
delivery (Hookshot bridges Alertmanager into a Matrix room) down.
